summary: iter192: Verified the STO Receive endpoint refactor that removes Playwright/SAP-UI-login from the flow. All 6 backend tests pass. The two ValueError -> 400 gates in inbound_receipt_service.prepare_receipt fire correctly: (a) gi_status != 'posted' returns 400 'nothing to receive', (b) gi_status='posted' but empty outbound_delivery_ids returns 400 'No SAP delivery reference found yet'. Unknown STO returns 400 'not found'. The receive endpoint block in server.py no longer references sap_playwright_pgr_service or post_goods_receipts_via_ui and now directly invokes inbound_receipt_service.receive_stock_transfer_order. Backend log tail contains no Playwright/browser-launch lines tied to inbound_receipt jobs during the test window. Per the review_request's safety constraint, did NOT trigger a real Receive against a live receivable STO (would post real SAP Goods Movement); instead relied on prior in-session live test of receive_stock_transfer_order against STO-000131 (~25s, no Playwright, per-line SAP rejection surfaced correctly) as positive-path evidence.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~9810 lines - well past the 700-line guideline; several unrelated endpoints (inbound receipts, GRN, STO create, admin auth, playwright retries) live in one module. Should be split into routers per feature area for maintainability. Not a blocker for this change.

inbound_receipt_service.receive_stock_transfer_order writes receipt_status/receipt_error to the STO doc directly, while server.py's run() exception handler ALSO does an independent $set of receipt_status='failed'/receipt_error=str(e) on any raised exception. If receive_stock_transfer_order raises AFTER partial DB update, both writes race - low risk today (function is mostly a single _relocate_receipt_from_hold call) but worth noting for future edits.
build_line_overrides docstring still references Playwright typing into SAP's Actual Quantity grid; that path is dead for STO Receive now. Doc-comment cleanup only.

The receive endpoint accepts payload.items overrides but the doc gate uses `doc.get('outbound_delivery_ids')`. If SAP delivery ref exists but underlying items list is empty (edge case), the flow will call _relocate_receipt_from_hold with no lines; skipped_no_items -> 'received' which may be misleading. Consider gating on items too.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The regression test lives at /app/tests/test_iter192_inbound_receive_no_playwright.py (NOT /app/backend/tests/ because that dir is watched by uvicorn --reload and modifying files there caused the backend to enter a shutdown loop during initial run - had to `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` to recover). Run with `pytest /app/tests/test_iter192_inbound_receive_no_playwright.py -v -p no:xdist`. The synthetic session token is embedded in the test file (SESSION_COOKIE constant) - rotate if expired. Positive-path (real SAP Goods Movement) is NOT covered by the automated test to avoid writing to prod SAP; user-owned iter171/172-style live test remains the recommended approach if a receivable STO becomes available.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bug found. This iteration was a verification-only run for a completed refactor. The refactor (removing Playwright from STO Receive) is correctly wired: prepare_receipt gates work, the endpoint's run() calls receive_stock_transfer_order directly, and _relocate_receipt_from_hold is the sole SAP action.
